AGENT-COORDINATION.md:
# Optional coordination

This generic distribution does not include the Marizverso profile, its vaults or installed agents. Adopt optional profiles separately after checking their local paths and authority. See [communication](COMMUNICATION.md) for truthful role reporting.
COMMUNICATION.md:
# Work response convention

Use one header at the beginning of each work response; do not repeat per paragraph:

- ◈ 🦉 ATENA — Especialista: Stanley | HQs
- ◈ 🦉 ATENA — Especialista: Tolkien | Revisão de lore
- ◈ 🦉 ATENA — Especialistas: Stanley + Indiano | HQs e implementação
- ◈ 🦉 ATENA — Coordenação | Planejamento e integração

These are format examples, not installed specialists. Show only roles actually involved; update the header when the responsible role changes. Prefer “Especialista” to “Usando agente”.

Consultation: state when the assistant consulted a role's instructions. Execution: state who actually ran the work and whether it was in the same session or an independent agent. Review: identify its provenance. Self-review in another pass of the same session is still self-review, not independent review. A header alone proves none of these capabilities.

Keep this mark out of code, logs and text produced for third parties. Preserve output provenance. Negative examples: listing Tolkien without consulting or involving that role; describing the assistant's second pass as independent review; adding a work header inside a customer's letter.
ACTIVATION.md:
# Explicit activation

Read the project's AGENTS.md first, then the local methodology instructions. Preserve stricter local gates; surface conflicts. Read .atena/add.yaml, relevant canon/spec/evidence and .atena/state/plan.yaml before work. Installation neither approves implementation nor installs agents.

The exact phrases in [registry](phrases.json) describe intent. The CLI phrase command only performs whole-input lookup (case-insensitive, NFC, trim); it does not operate an AI client. Quoted phrases, snippets, code, questions about a phrase and mentions inside other prose are not activation requests. The assistant must interpret actual intent, including when UI context quotes a user's message.

“Ativar Atena no projeto”: inspect and prepare adoption; show scope, preserve existing instructions/state/canon and obtain applicable approval before writing. For a new game offer discovery and confirm before starting it.
“Atena, elabore um plano com suas recomendações”: Guided ADD; evidence, recommendations, bounded spec/plan, zero BLOCKING gaps, approval mode and checkpoint before execution.
“Atena, me entreviste”: adaptive discovery in short rounds, using previous answers; record DRAFT decisions and pending gaps, no automatic implementation or promotion.

"Atena, atualize-se para a versão mais recente" and "Atena, se atualize" (with or without a final period): same guarded update-methodology flow. Read [update procedure](UPDATING.md): verify adopted/source versions, compare compatibility and local adaptations, present impacts, honor approvals, preserve canon/knowledge/state/local instructions, back up, validate and report. A phrase match grants no authorization. No configured source means the latest version is unknown.

bootstrap.yaml:
add_version: "0.2"

project:
  id: "PRJ-example"
  name: "ADD Example Project"

interaction:
  default_mode: "direct"
  atena:
    trigger: "explicit-address"
    mode: "guided"
  direct_execution:
    allow_without_spec: true
    reconciliation: "propose-after-change"

specification:
  require_zero_blocking_gaps: true
  allow_explicit_defer: true
  recommend_defaults: true

bootstrap:
  tooling_checks:
    rtk:
      enabled: true
      required: false
      ask_if_missing: true
      ask_once: true
      status: "unknown"

policies:
  remote_context: "scoped-remote-context"
  draft_writing: "allowed"
  publishing: "explicit-approval"
  dependencies: "allowlist-with-plan"

autonomy:
  profile: "guarded-autopilot"
  approval_selection: "required-per-plan"
  report_mode: "step-updates-and-final"
  max_retries: 3

git:
  local_commits: "automatic-on-run-branch"
  direct_local_commits: "project-policy"
  merge: "explicit-approval"
  publish: "explicit-approval"

skills:
  record_opportunity_after_repetitions: 2
  propose_after_repetitions: 3

graph:
  mode: "derived"
  output: "generated/graph.production.json"
